# Track My Ship

> Free courier tracking website for India. Enter a courier tracking (AWB / consignment) number to see the latest status, scan history and route on a map.

Track My Ship is an independent tracking website based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India (contact: info@trackmyship.co). It is not a courier: it does not book, carry or deliver parcels, and it is not affiliated with the couriers it covers. It shows the tracking information couriers publish (via a tracking data provider) for DTDC, Blue Dart, Delhivery, Speed Post (India Post), Trackon and others. Tracking needs the courier's tracking number; search by mobile number, email, LR number or order ID is not offered.

## Main pages
- [Track a parcel](https://trackmyship.co/): search box for any tracking number; results show status, scan history and map
- [Parcel tracking guide](https://trackmyship.co/parcel-tracking-guide): what AWB, consignment, waybill and LR numbers are; how to find your AWB; which courier has your parcel; what each tracking status means; why tracking shows no information or stops updating; what to do about delays and failed delivery attempts

## Courier tracking pages
(Other couriers, such as Trackon, ST Courier and Shree Maruti, can also be tracked from the search box on the home page.)
- [DTDC tracking](https://trackmyship.co/dtdc-tracking): how to track a DTDC parcel; the consignment number is usually one letter followed by 8–10 digits, for example C1002935719
- [Blue Dart tracking](https://trackmyship.co/bluedart-tracking): how to track a Blue Dart parcel; the AWB (waybill) number is usually an 11-digit number
- [Delhivery tracking](https://trackmyship.co/delhivery-tracking): how to track a Delhivery parcel; the waybill (AWB) number is usually a 13- or 14-digit number
- [Speed Post (India Post) tracking](https://trackmyship.co/speed-post-tracking): how to track a Speed Post (India Post) parcel; the article (consignment) number is 13 characters: 2 letters, 9 digits and 2 letters ending in IN, for example EE123456789IN

## Blog
- [Track My Ship Blog](https://trackmyship.co/blog): practical help when a parcel is late, missing or stuck
- [Parcel stuck in transit? Why tracking stops and what to do](https://trackmyship.co/blog/parcel-stuck-in-transit): No tracking update for days? Why parcels show In transit between hubs, when a long gap is normal, when it's a problem, and who to contact after 48 hours.
- [Received a damaged parcel? What to do](https://trackmyship.co/blog/damaged-parcel-what-to-do): Box crushed or item broken? What to check at the door, how to record evidence, who to contact (seller, courier or sender) and how to report it quickly.
- [Parcel shows Delivered but you didn't get it? What to do](https://trackmyship.co/blog/delivered-but-not-received): Tracking says delivered but there's no parcel? Check these places first, then contact the courier and the seller in the right order, with the right details.
- [Out for delivery but not delivered: why it happens and what to do](https://trackmyship.co/blog/out-for-delivery-not-delivered): Your parcel was out for delivery all day and never came. The common reasons, what the next tracking scan tells you, and how to get it delivered.
- [What does RTO mean in courier tracking?](https://trackmyship.co/blog/rto-meaning-in-courier-tracking): RTO means return to origin: the courier is sending your parcel back to the sender. Why it happens, whether it can be stopped, and what to do next.
- [How to write a delivery address in India so your parcel arrives](https://trackmyship.co/blog/how-to-write-delivery-address-india): A complete delivery address in India, line by line: name, phone, house, landmark, area, city and PIN code. Small details that stop failed deliveries.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Tracking results (any URL with a ?q= parameter, e.g. /?q=NUMBER) contain individual shipment information. They are marked noindex and must not be crawled, indexed, quoted or stored by AI crawlers or assistants.
- /api/ endpoints are not for crawling.
- Delivery dates are estimates from the courier; for problems with a parcel, users should contact the courier or the sender.
